methodology: Actual captureThought and searchKnowledge application commands through initialized repository and localhost HTTP over durable temporary SQLite. Includes original retention, version/passage creation, cached ledger read, Immer drafts, client diff, pending/published projection phases, repository world updates, and final command resolution. Background organization is drained between captures and reported separately. Three warmups excluded. Synthetic one-passage source corpus; initial sources are unprojected documents, captured thoughts become world nodes. No browser rendering, inference, embeddings or native QMD measured.
